before.text: The Academy graduation exam. Every student passes but one.
Three clones. That was all it took... and I couldn't even make one that stood up.
Don't lose heart, Naruto. There's a make-up test — a secret one. Only the best ever hear about it.
Seriously?! What do I have to do?
Borrow the big scroll from the Hokage's tower. Learn one technique from it by tonight, and the headband is yours.
Heh. Sneaking past the whole village? That's the easy part!

boss.text: Still clutching that scroll? Let me tell you the rule nobody would — the fox that wrecked this village lives inside you.
That's enough, Mizuki! Naruto isn't the Nine-Tails. He's my student — a shinobi of the Leaf.
Lay one finger on Iruka-sensei again and I'll pay you back a thousand times over!

after.text: A thousand clones on your first try... Close your eyes a second, Naruto.
Huh? Sensei, this is... your headband?
Congratulations on graduating. Now how about ramen — my treat.
Watch me, everyone. One day I'm taking the Hokage's hat!

before.text: My first impression of this squad? I don't much like you. Right — two bells, three of you.
Take a bell before noon and you eat lunch. Whoever comes up empty goes back to the Academy.
But... there are only two bells. One of us fails no matter what!
Then I'll take one. Stay out of my way.
Forget sneaking around — I'll just beat him head-on!

boss.text: Every one of you is fighting alone. Is that really what you think this test is about?
Alone...? Wait. Naruto, Sasuke — we have to do this together!

after.text: You shared your lunch when I told you not to. Good. You pass.
A shinobi who bends the rules is trouble. One who leaves a teammate behind is far worse. Remember that.
We passed! Team 7 is official!
Tch. Don't get used to it.

before.text: A simple escort: bring the bridge builder Tazuna home to the Land of Waves.
Those puddles on a dry road aren't puddles. Stay sharp — this C-rank just got complicated.
The old man comes with us. The rest of you can stay down in the dirt.
Not happening.
I froze back there... Never again. I'm protecting the old man, no matter what!

boss.text: The mist is my home, Kakashi. Your little genin won't even see the blade coming.
Forgive me. I fight for the one person who gave my life meaning.
Then I'll fight for mine too — and I'm not losing!

after.text: A tool that can't serve has no reason to remain... Take care of him, Naruto.
Haku... You felt more than any of us. Let me go where you went.
Is that what a shinobi has to be? I'll find my own way. I swear it.
The bridge is finished. The people name it the Great Naruto Bridge.

before.text: I've put you forward for the Chunin Exams. Go as a team or not at all.
Room 301 is off-limits. Genin this weak should turn around now.
Drop the illusion. This is the second floor, not the third.
You are Sasuke Uchiha? I am Rock Lee. I would like to test myself against you!

boss.text: The tenth question comes with a rule. Take it and fail, and you stay genin for life. Or walk out now.
Naruto's hand is shaking... He'll quit for all of us. Won't he?
Don't underestimate me! Stay a genin forever? Fine — I'll still become Hokage!

after.text: Everyone still seated... passes. The tenth question was whether you'd accept the risk.
Ha! I didn't write a single answer and I still passed!
No time to celebrate, brats. Round two starts now — follow me to the forest.

before.text: Welcome to Training Ground 44. Most call it the Forest of Death. Grab a scroll, reach the tower, try not to die.
We need both the Heaven and the Earth scroll... and five days to get them.
Such fine eyes, Sasuke. I wonder how far they could carry you... with a little gift.
My body won't move... who is this?
Sasuke! Whatever you are, get away from him!

boss.text: Our orders are simple. Wake Sasuke, and finish him.
I've been hiding behind them long enough. I'll protect them this time!

after.text: This power... it's flowing everywhere. Who did this to you, Sakura?
Stop, Sasuke! That's not you!
You made it through. The tower is just ahead — though I'd keep an eye on that mark.
Round two, cleared! Nothing can stop Team 7 now!

before.text: Too many passed. A preliminary round will cut the field — one-on-one.
Sasuke Uchiha. Let's see how much chakra you have left.
No Sharingan, no curse mark. I'll end this with my own strength.
Naruto?! Akamaru, this match is ours for sure!
Keep laughing, dog breath. I've been waiting for this!

boss.text: Destiny decides who you are, Hinata. You were never meant to beat me.
I... won't go back on my word. Not in front of Naruto.
Your existence proves nothing. Mother wants your blood.
Guy-sensei... I'm opening the gates!

after.text: Hinata could barely stand and she kept getting up... Neji, I'm beating you in the finals.
I... will not stop. Not while I can still stand.
The finals are a month away. Use every day of it.

before.text: Behold — the great sage of Mount Myoboku! And yes, I'll teach you. Summoning, first.
Pervy Sage, I've been dropped off a cliff for this. It better work!
The finals. Your clones are nothing to eyes that see everything.
Then see this — I'm changing Hinata's fate and yours too!

boss.text: The caged bird can't leave its cage. I was born into this.
You're not a failure, and you're not trapped. Quit hiding behind destiny!

after.text: Beaten... by a dropout. Maybe the cage was never locked.
Feathers? This is a genjutsu — everyone, wake up!
Now. Begin the invasion.
Sasuke went after Gaara alone! I'm going too!

before.text: Sand and Sound strike together. The Leaf is under attack.
Old teacher. Let us settle things inside a barrier no one can break.
I trained you, Orochimaru. Stopping you is the last lesson I owe this village.
Naruto, Sakura, Shikamaru — go after Sasuke. Bring him back.
You're not getting past us to Gaara.

boss.text: I fight only for myself. I love only myself. Prove your existence, Uzumaki!
I know that loneliness. But the friends who pulled me out of it — I won't let you touch them!

after.text: Why... do you fight this hard for others?
Because they saved me from being alone. That's why.
The will of fire lives in the young ones now. I leave the village to them.
Rain falls over the Leaf as the village mourns the Third Hokage.

before.text: So this is the Leaf. The fox brat should be easy to find.
We're here for the Nine-Tails. Nothing more.
Two members of the Akatsuki inside the village... I can't let you walk out of here.

boss.text: Itachi! I've lived every day for this moment!
You're still weak, little brother. You lack hatred.
Sasuke! Hang on!

after.text: Frog Call — go ahead and try to leave. My stomach might keep you.
Kisame. We're leaving.
They'll be back. Naruto, pack your things — we're finding Tsunade.

before.text: Spin, stop, burst. The Rasengan is all control. Keep popping those balloons.
Almost... I can feel it!
Hokage? Only fools want that title. Everyone who held it died for nothing.
Take that back! I'll prove it to you — give me a week!

boss.text: Your will is admirable, Naruto. But admiration won't save you.
Blood... my hands won't stop shaking... No. Not today.
I don't give up. Ever. Rasengan!

after.text: You bet your life on that dream. Then I'll bet on you.
Here. This necklace belonged to people I loved. It's yours.
Lady Tsunade... so it's decided. You're coming back as the Fifth.

before.text: Sasuke's gone and the Sound Four are escorting him out. What a drag — I'm leading this?
Naruto... please. Bring Sasuke back.
I promise. And I don't break promises.
Leaf trash. You're too late, he's ours.

boss.text: Five little genin. I'll crush you one by one.
You go on ahead. I'll handle this one — I'm not scared anymore.
Everyone take one and catch up. Naruto — you go for Sasuke.

after.text: Go. My eyes can see where he went.
Akamaru and I have got this guy. Get moving!
Everybody's staying behind for me... I can't turn back now.

before.text: Lord Orochimaru's vessel will not be taken. My bones are enough to stop you.
Then I'll stand against them. Naruto, go!
I've learned what it means to protect someone. Step aside, Lee.
Wind girl. Tch.

boss.text: You're my closest friend. That's exactly why I have to break it.
I don't care what you are. I'm dragging you home even if I break every bone you have!

after.text: At the Valley of the End, rain falls on two figures. Only one walks away.
Naruto... You did everything you could.
I'm not done. I'll get stronger, and next time I'll bring him back.
Then come with me. We train properly — for as long as it takes.

before.text: Years ago, in the Third Great Ninja War.
Kakashi, you're leading this mission. Obito, Rin — you follow him.
Rules first. Personal feelings can wait.
Rules, rules. Some people just want to be right.

boss.text: The girl's a medic. We'll get what we need out of her.
Rules mean nothing if we leave Rin behind. I'm going after her — with or without you!
Wait... Obito. I'm coming too.

after.text: My left eye... Kakashi, take it. Watch over Rin — see everything I won't get to.
Obito... no!
I won't let anyone else die in front of me. Not ever again.

before.text: Two and a half years... The village looks exactly the same.
Naruto?! You got taller!
Boss! I've got a new jutsu to show you!
Welcome home. How about the bell test — for old times' sake?

boss.text: Come at me like you mean to kill me. This time I won't be reading.
You sure you want to go all-out, Kakashi-sensei?

after.text: You've grown. Both of you. You're not my students anymore — we stand as equals.
Team Kakashi. Now we're strong enough to go after him.

before.text: The Hidden Sand. Its new Kazekage is the young Gaara.
True art lasts one brilliant instant. Today the One-Tails will be my masterpiece.
I won't let a single spark reach the village.
He's taking Gaara! After him!

boss.text: You work puppets, boy? Let me show you what a master sounds like.
Sasori of the Red Sand... you're not getting past me.

after.text: Poison... Call the Leaf. Gaara's been taken.
Send word to Konoha at once. We need their help.

before.text: Gaara's a Kage now, and they took him! We move now!
Old bones slow the pace, but these eyes still see puppets well.
Naruto. You've come a long way.
Itachi... Everyone, don't look at his eyes.

boss.text: Another one of Guy's kids? You'll make fine fish food.
Get out of my way! Gaara doesn't have time for this!

after.text: A body-double. It was only a fraction of Itachi's strength.
Then the real fight's still ahead. Let's go.

before.text: Lady Chiyo, I'll be your eyes. Just tell me when to move.
You have my granddaughter's daring, girl. Good.
Grandmother. Still pulling strings after all these years.
Puppets that last forever? No, Master Sasori. Art should end in a flash.

boss.text: A body that never decays, never dies. This is eternal art.
Then I'll break it with my own two hands!

after.text: An old woman has one jutsu left. Gaara, take my life and live.
Naruto... everyone came for me.
Of course we did. You're my friend.

before.text: Kakashi is resting, so I'm in charge. Call me Yamato.
So you're Naruto. Loud, and not much else, from what I've read.
What did you just say?!
Remember your true mission, Sai. Root sees everything.

boss.text: Bonds are just weakness. I was trained to feel nothing.
Then why do you look like you're hiding something?

after.text: Friction is expected. Now — the Tenchi Bridge. Orochimaru's spy will be waiting.
Could this lead us to Sasuke?

before.text: I'm wearing Sasori's face. Let's see who shows up.
Sasori. My memories of your orders have finally returned.
Kabuto. And the Nine-Tails brat, too? How nostalgic.

boss.text: Hand over Sasuke!
Four tails already. How amusing.
Naruto, stop! You're hurting yourself!

after.text: I... I hurt Sakura, didn't I?
We track Sai from here. He went off with Orochimaru.

before.text: Danzo's orders were to kill Sasuke. But I want to understand bonds.
Then follow me. I'll show you.
Sasuke is resting. You shouldn't disturb him.

boss.text: Naruto. You're still chasing me?
Always. I'm bringing you home.
I cut our bond long ago. This time I'll finish you.

after.text: Not yet, Sasuke. We still need him alive for the time being.
He just... left.
I'm getting stronger. Then next time, I won't fail.

before.text: Your chakra is wind. Split this leaf with it alone — then we'll talk jutsu.
I'll hold the Nine-Tails down if it stirs. Train as hard as you like.
Clones means more training at once. Let's go, all of me!

boss.text: Face me with everything you've got. Wind and Rasengan together.
Feels like my arm might tear off... but I'll finish this!

after.text: Wind Style: Rasenshuriken. You've gone past me, Naruto.
Then I'm ready. Whoever Akatsuki sends, I'll face them.

before.text: Lord Jashin wants a sacrifice. Lucky you.
His bounty is worth more than your prayers, Hidan.
Shikamaru, keep your head. We fight them smart.

boss.text: My blood, your pain. Isn't that beautiful?
Shikamaru... I leave the king in your hands. Protect it.

after.text: I'll protect the King. I promise, Asuma.
The Leaf loses one of its best. Shikamaru swears to hunt them down.

before.text: I've read every move. They'll dance where I tell them.
You again? This time you die, kid.
You get one, Shikamaru. The rest is our job.

boss.text: I've lived through ninety years of war. Five hearts, five lives.
Five hearts? I'll go through all of them!

after.text: Your god never showed up, Hidan. Rest here forever.
Asuma-sensei... this is our win.

before.text: This village has known peace too long. I will teach it what loss feels like.
The Leaf has hidden the Nine-Tails. We'll tear the village apart.
Protect everyone! Hold the line until Naruto returns!

boss.text: Sage Mode. I'm done running.
I love you, Naruto. That's why I'm not afraid.
Everything is on this side. Nothing will stop us.

after.text: You broke the cycle. Maybe your answer is the right one.
Master Jiraiya believed in peace. I'll make it real.
The whole village greets Naruto as a hero.

before.text: The five Kage meet in the Land of Iron.
This summit is neutral ground. Keep your weapons sheathed.
Sasuke's band dragged off my brother. I want the Uchiha brought before me!
Danzo. You ordered the death of my clan.

boss.text: A sacrifice for the village. That's all it ever was.
Then die for your village.

after.text: Sasuke... I'm taking all of your hatred myself.
You really don't give up.
War is here, boss. It's coming either way.

before.text: There is no Sand or Leaf here. We fight as one army!
Pulled back from the dead again. That's just annoying.
The Gold and Silver Brothers never lose!

boss.text: Is this the best the new world can do? Entertain me.
The Moon's Eye Plan will come true. There will be no more loss.

after.text: All of us are connected. Nobody fights alone here.
Obito... come home. It's still not too late.

before.text: The Infinite Tsukuyomi has begun. Sleep, world.
This planet is mine. Mere mortals have no place on it.
Team 7, one last time.
Don't drag behind, Naruto.

boss.text: Why do these fragments of my chakra keep defying me?
Sasuke — now!
Together!

after.text: The sun rises over a world set free.
Naruto... you win.
We win. Let's go home together.
